_note: Practitioner roster read from Sak Yant Chiang Mai's own public master profiles (sakyantchiangmai.com/sak-yant-masters-in-chiang-mai/). Recorded as DATA — lineage, teachers, temples, years in and out of the robe — not reproduced as their copy. This is a living lineage map: it is the one place in the whole survey where teacher-to-student descent is stated plainly and at scale.
_caution: Self-reported by the operator. Treat years and generation counts as claims, not verified fact. Spellings are theirs.
